## About JSON2X

JSON2X is a free suite of 21 developer tools for converting, validating, inspecting,
and generating code from JSON and CSV data. Every tool runs 100% client-side in the
browser: the data a user pastes never leaves their device and is never sent to a
server. There is no registration, no login, no file upload step, and no paid tier.

Primary URL:  https://json2x.com
Source code:  https://github.com/arjunn881/json2x
License:      MIT
URL format:   canonical paths carry no trailing slash (https://json2x.com/tools/json-formatter)

## How the tools work

Every tool page uses the same two-pane workspace: input on the left, output on the
right. Output regenerates as you type. Results can be copied to the clipboard or
downloaded as a file. Parse errors are reported inline with the exact line number.
Because processing is local, the tools work offline and behind corporate firewalls.

## Core Developer Tools (21)

### Format & Validate
- JSON Formatter & Beautifier Online: https://json2x.com/tools/json-formatter
  Pretty-print minified JSON with syntax highlighting and 2-space, 4-space, or tab indentation.
- JSON Validator & Syntax Linter: https://json2x.com/tools/json-validator
  Strict RFC 8259 syntax checking with exact line and character-position error reporting.
- JSON Minifier & Compressor Online: https://json2x.com/tools/json-minifier
  Strip all whitespace and report the exact byte savings, typically 20-40% for API payloads.
- JSON Diff & Comparison Online: https://json2x.com/tools/json-diff
  Semantic side-by-side comparison of two JSON trees with colour-coded added, removed, and changed keys.

### Data Converters
- JSON to CSV Converter Online: https://json2x.com/tools/json-to-csv
  Flatten JSON arrays into spreadsheet-ready CSV for Excel, Google Sheets, and pandas, with a chosen delimiter.
- CSV to JSON Converter Online: https://json2x.com/tools/csv-to-json
  Parse CSV and TSV into typed JSON arrays with automatic delimiter and header detection.
- JSON to YAML & YAML to JSON Converter: https://json2x.com/tools/json-to-yaml
  Two-way conversion between JSON and YAML 1.2 for Kubernetes, Docker Compose, and Ansible.
- JSON to XML & XML to JSON Converter: https://json2x.com/tools/json-to-xml
  Two-way conversion between JSON and XML for SOAP, RSS, and enterprise integration payloads.
- JSON to TOML Converter Online: https://json2x.com/tools/json-to-toml
  Convert JSON to TOML v1.0.0 for Rust Cargo.toml, Python pyproject.toml, and Hugo configs.
- JSON to SQL Table & INSERT Converter: https://json2x.com/tools/json-to-sql
  Generate CREATE TABLE DDL and INSERT statements for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite.
### Code & Schema Generators
- JSON Multi-Converter: 7-in-1 Code & Schema Generator: https://json2x.com/tools/json-converter
  Generate TypeScript, Zod, Mongoose, SQL, OpenAPI, JSON Schema, and mock data from one payload at once.
- JSON to TypeScript Interface & Type Generator: https://json2x.com/tools/typescript-generator
  Generate TypeScript interfaces and type aliases, with optional properties inferred from the sample.
- JSON to Go Structs, Rust Serde & Python Models: https://json2x.com/tools/json-to-code
  Generate Go structs with json tags, Rust Serde models, and Python Pydantic v2 classes.
- JSON Schema Generator Online (Draft-07 & 2020-12): https://json2x.com/tools/json-schema-generator
  Infer a JSON Schema with required properties, types, and format validators from sample data.
- JSON Mock Data Generator Online: https://json2x.com/tools/json-mock-generator
  Generate realistic synthetic datasets for API testing without exposing production PII.
- JSON to Zod Schema Generator Online: https://json2x.com/tools/json-to-zod
  Infer z.object() runtime validation schemas for tRPC, React Hook Form, and Express middleware.
- JSON to Prisma Schema Model Generator: https://json2x.com/tools/json-to-prisma
  Generate Prisma ORM model definitions with mapped scalar types for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite.
- JSON to Drizzle ORM Schema Generator: https://json2x.com/tools/json-to-drizzle
  Generate Drizzle pgTable, mysqlTable, and sqliteTable definitions with correct column types.
- JSON to GraphQL Schema SDL Generator: https://json2x.com/tools/json-to-graphql
  Generate GraphQL SDL type definitions and nullability from a JSON payload structure.

### Query & Inspection
- JSONPath Evaluator & Query Tester Online: https://json2x.com/tools/jsonpath
  Evaluate RFC 9535 JSONPath expressions against live JSON with a built-in syntax cheat sheet.
- JSON Tree Viewer & Interactive Visualizer: https://json2x.com/tools/json-tree-viewer
  Explore JSON as a collapsible tree with key and value search, plus node and depth counts.

## Privacy & Trust

JSON2X operates under a zero-telemetry architecture:
- All parsing and conversion happens locally in the browser
- No network request is made while a tool runs
- No user data is uploaded, logged, or retained
- Fully usable offline and behind corporate firewalls
- No cookies, no tracking, no analytics
- Source code is public: https://github.com/arjunn881/json2x

This is why JSON2X is safe for pasting production API responses, customer records,
and internal payloads that must not leave a machine.
